origin.handoffEntry: MIK-R97@v9 part F item 7 (the consistency check)

realizes.rationale: It names the ten command names for which the consistency check requires no table row or documentation mention.

This checker authenticates recognized historical d694 and frozen owners against their retained budget-record hashes after same-owner byte, unique-key and schema checks. The live digest map is schema-checked without the removed decision.currentDigestMapSha256 pin, and parsed equality with the current budget record applies only to that current-budget owner. This implements the existing historical-authentication boundary of INV-NDGJ3M without freezing current derived delivery carriers; audience-projection semantics are not claimed for this helper.
